title: Computation Note: Amount of the Rental Vehicle Coordination Self-Pay Charge
content:
**Computation.** On a returned Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental, the self-pay days are the rental days less the rental days that start on or before the coverage end recorded on the reservation, never below zero; the self-pay day rate is the class partner daily rate; and the self-pay charge is the self-pay days at the self-pay day rate, rounded to the cent once at the end. The self-pay charge is booked for its self-pay days as the days it covers.

Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day. The first rental day starts on the pickup date and each later one a calendar day after the one before, so the rental days starting on or before the recorded coverage end are the whole days from the pickup date to that date, plus one, never more than all rental days; where no coverage end is recorded there are none.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Pickup and return dates and times, recorded coverage end | The reservation |
| Class partner daily rate | The class rate schedule, for the class rented |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A Full-Size Rental (partner daily rate 52.99 USD) is picked up on the 1st at 10:00 and returned on the 12th at 11:00: 11 whole days and a later return time, so 12 rental days. The recorded coverage end is the 8th, so 8 rental days start on or before it. The self-pay days are 4 and the self-pay charge is 4 days at 52.99 USD, 211.96 USD, booked as covering 4 days.

## Boundary cases (same rental, hypothetical coverage ends)

| Recorded coverage end | Rental days starting on or before it | Self-pay days | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 12th | 12 | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| The 11th | 11 | 1 | 52.99 USD |
| The 15th | 12 (never more than all rental days) | 0 | 0.00 USD |
